title: saxifraga hirculus subsp. alpina
intro: Saxifraga hirculus subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Saxifrage, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Saxifragaceae. It is a perennial herb that grows in rocky areas and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Saxifraga hirculus subsp. alpina include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective properties.
